articles.summary: Ekho’s new Lead Capture feature connects online interest with in-store sales. Instead of losing high-intent shoppers who stop short of checkout, dealers can now convert them seamlessly through a “Buy In-Person” option. Each lead is verified, logged, and instantly shared with your store—turning potential buyers into real customers. Built on a new modular checkout architecture, the system adapts dynamically across channels, keeping every potential sale in sight and every team in sync.
articles.title: Turn Browsers Into Buyers: Ekho’s New Lead Capture Flow
